questions.question: What made the psalmist glad in Psalm 122?
options: When they said, 'Let us return to the land of Egypt!'
When they said, 'Let us build a city and a tower!'
When they said, 'Let us choose a king to rule us!'
When they said, 'Let us go to the house of the LORD!'
questions.answer: When they said, 'Let us go to the house of the LORD!'

questions.question: For what does the psalm urge prayer?
options: For the strength of the army
For the wealth of the nation
For the wisdom of the king

questions.question: The psalm describes Jerusalem as a city bound firmly together where the tribes go up.
I was _____ when they said to me, 'Let us go to the house of the LORD!'
Pray for the _____ of Jerusalem! May they be secure who love you!
